gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans: Wrench-wide curves and stroke after stroke of uniform line: that is Baumans. Encode Sans follows underneath in sans-serif form, its gaps keeping each c clearly apart from an o, so the heading's loud shapes get a readable partner.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Distinctive, stencil-cut letters from Baumans, all one width. Encode Sans Expanded gives the pair its strongest quality, a friendly, widely spread body whose c tips pull well apart, which softens the heading's commanding look without dulling it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Encode Sans SC reads as a plain sans with a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap, easy to follow along a line. Baumans is the one that commands attention, while the body simply keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans-semi-conde: Encode Sans Semi Condensed keeps its s open and its counters generous, giving text a modern, approachable feel. And Baumans, with no thick or thin parts in any letter, sits above it, so extended reading stays smooth rather than tiring.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans-semi-expan: Commanding comes first, with Baumans tracing every line as if with a single marker tip, while Encode Sans Semi Expanded keeps its rounded letters left open. They feel like a bold announcement followed by a friendly, contemporary reply.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-exo: Baumans brings flat, unmodulated lines and a crescent-wrench c, giving the heading a distinctive, commanding look. Exo's wide gaps keep tiny sizes crisp, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-faculty-glyphic: Horizontals as thick as the verticals make Baumans instantly recognizable, with a c opened like a wrench. But Faculty Glyphic keeps a modern, professional tone below it, its rounded letters showing clear openings.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-fahkwang: Baumans draws hairline-free, swell-free letterforms, every stroke the same weight, and a c like an opened wrench. It handles bold announcements, while Fahkwang handles the quieter text, with faint nib-pressure variation.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-figtree: Figtree reads like marker-drawn sans-serif letters, with an e whose terminal gap is wide and welcoming. Baumans sits above it as the commanding voice, one thickness throughout, and Figtree takes over once the heading has made its entrance.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-finlandica: Finlandica reads clean and contemporary, with open-mouthed e crossbars. Baumans handles commanding, wrench-wide display shapes at a single stroke width, while Finlandica's constant-width outline carries the sans-serif text you can follow with a finger.
